scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@errandwebapp/shared && npm run build --workspace=@errandwebapp/frontend && npm run build --workspace=@errandwebapp/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@errandwebapp/frontend && npm run lint --workspace=@errandwebapp/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@errandwebapp/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@errandwebapp/backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@errandwebapp/backend && npm run test --workspace=@errandwebapp/frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=@errandwebapp/backend && npm run test:coverage --workspace=@errandwebapp/frontend
scripts.setup: node -e "const os = require('os'); const { exec } = require('child_process'); const script = os.platform() === 'win32' ? 'scripts/setup.bat' : 'bash scripts/setup.sh'; exec(script, (err, stdout, stderr) => { if (stdout) console.log(stdout); if (stderr) console.error(stderr); if (err) process.exit(1); });"
scripts.quick-start: node -e "const os = require('os'); const { exec } = require('child_process'); const script = os.platform() === 'win32' ? 'scripts/start.bat' : 'bash scripts/start.sh'; exec(script, (err, stdout, stderr) => { if (stdout) console.log(stdout); if (stderr) console.error(stderr); if (err) process.exit(1); });"
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && rm -rf apps/*/node_modules apps/*/package-lock.json && rm -rf apps/*/.next apps/*/dist
scripts.clean:win: rmdir /s /q node_modules & del package-lock.json & rmdir /s /q apps\frontend\node_modules apps\backend\node_modules & rmdir /s /q apps\frontend\.next apps\backend\dist
scripts.mongo:start: node -e "const os = require('os'); const { exec } = require('child_process'); const cmd = os.platform() === 'win32' ? 'net start MongoDB' : (os.platform() === 'darwin' ? 'brew services start mongodb/brew/mongodb-community' : 'sudo systemctl start mongod'); exec(cmd, (err, stdout) => { console.log(stdout || 'MongoDB start attempted'); });"
scripts.mongo:stop: node -e "const os = require('os'); const { exec } = require('child_process'); const cmd = os.platform() === 'win32' ? 'net stop MongoDB' : (os.platform() === 'darwin' ? 'brew services stop mongodb/brew/mongodb-community' : 'sudo systemctl stop mongod'); exec(cmd, (err, stdout) => { console.log(stdout || 'MongoDB stop attempted'); });"
scripts.docker:mongo:stop: docker stop errand-mongodb && docker rm errand-mongodb
